title: Exploit Chain: Authentication Control Compounding - Token Exposure + No Rotation + No Revocation + No Inactive Check
description: Step 1: Refresh token exposed in login response (finding-028, CWE-200). Step 2: No refresh token rotation (finding-033, CWE-613) - stolen token valid for full 7-day lifetime. Step 3: No revocation check (finding-030, CWE-306) - even revoked tokens work. Step 4: No inactive account check (finding-031, CWE-306) - banned users can still authenticate. Combined: Any stolen refresh token provides persistent, undetectable access even for banned accounts.
impact: Complete authentication control bypass. Stolen refresh tokens provide indefinite, undetectable access regardless of account status or revocation attempts. Token theft = permanent account compromise.
mitigation: 1) Remove refresh_token from response body; use HttpOnly cookies. 2) Implement refresh token rotation with revocation. 3) Add revocation check in authentication middleware. 4) Add user.status === ACTIVE check in authentication flow.
